provenance.source: Original RGB source, inspected at native resolution.

annotation_quality_audit.rule: At least 75 percent of each intended boundary must genuinely be pigment-colored at RGB distance 80 or more from paper; intentional white or cream subject highlights are foreground and cannot be treated as contamination.
annotation_quality_audit.edge_probe_result: PASS with no replacements: all three intended outer silhouettes are pigment-lined; their white strokes and dots are internal highlights rather than boundary truth.
annotation_quality_audit.enclosed_background_result: PASS: all four centers are visibly blank white paper, not pale paint; their source RGB distance from white is at most 5.4.

provenance.note: All guards and edge boxes were selected from the original source without inspecting any candidate. Sure-FG points deliberately span pale bubbles, kelp, coral, shell, starfish, and the authored base wash. Interior sure-BG points are visually blank paper gaps, not white highlights painted on subjects.
